include_poly.title: Include Poly
include_poly.description: Comma-separated URL(s) of .poly file(s) defining regions to include

default_view.title: Default View
default_view.description: Default map view as latitude,longitude,zoom (e.g. 46.51,6.63,14 for Kiwix headquarters). Sets the initial center and zoom level of the map when UI loads. zoom value is optional, you can pass only latitude,longitude (map will be zoomed out as much as possible).

file_name.title: ZIM filename
file_name.description: ZIM filename. Do not input trailing `.zim`, it will be automatically added. Defaults to {name}_{period}

tags.title: ZIM tags
tags.description: Semicolon (;) delimited list of tags to add to the ZIM

secondary_color.title: Secondary Color
secondary_color.description: Secondary (background) color of ZIM UI. Hex/HTML syntax (#424242)

illustration_url.title: Illustration URL
illustration_url.description: URL to illustration to use for ZIM illustration and favicon

zim_workers.title: ZIM workers
zim_workers.description: Number of threads to process items in libzim at ZIM creation

area.title: Area
area.description: Area to download, either planet or monaco

stats_filename.title: Stats Filename
stats_filename.description: Scraping progress file. Leave it as `/output/task_progress.json`

max_zoom.title: Max Zoom
max_zoom.description: Maximum zoom level of tiles to include in the ZIM. Tiles with zoom level higher than this value will be excluded. Must be between 0 and 18 (inclusive). Default: no limit (all zoom levels included).
